breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). The agent correctly identified this conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the periodic condition. The generated specification only includes the instruction to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges matching u(x,y)=x^2 - y^2', which resolves the inconsistency.
